spans.s:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Untaught, ignorant.
E.
अ neg. शिक्षित taught.

Eaten.
2

Satisfied.
E.
अश to eat, क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Warm, hot.
E.
अ not, शीत cold.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Black or dark blue.
m. (-तः)
1 Black, (the colour.)
2 A name of the planet

Saturn.
3

The dark fortnight of a lunar month.
f. (-ता)
1 The indigo plant.
E.
अ neg. and सित white.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Eaten.
E.
आङ् before अश to eat, affix क्त; also अशित.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Sat down.
2 Who sits or is seated.
n. (-तं)
1 Place of abode, a city.
2 A seat.
E.
आस to sit, क्त aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Formerly grazed by cattle, (a field, &c.)
E.
अशित eaten, and गवीन relating to cattle; also आशितङ्गवीन.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Formerly grazed by cattle.
E.
आशित eaten, गवीन irregular derivative of गो a cow, and खश् affix; also अशितङ्गवीन.

m. (-त्रः)
A thief.
E.
अशू to pervade, इत्र Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Firm, tight, hard.
E.
अ neg. शिथिल loose.

m. (-रः)
1 A name of the sun.
2

Fire.
3

A goblin or demon.
f. (-रा)
The wife of a goblin.
n. (-रं)
A diamond.
E.
अश to eat, and इर affix; what eats sacrifices, &c.

Fire.
2

A goblin or imp.
E.
आङ् before अश to eat, किरच् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-राः-राः-रः)
Headless.
E.
अ neg. शिरस् the head.

n. (-नं)
Bathing the body with exception of the head.
E.
अ neg. शिरस् the head, स्नान bathing.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Unlucky, unfortunate.
E.
अ neg. शिव propitious.

f. (-वी)
A female demon or goblin.

f. (-का)
See the following.
E.
कन् added to अशिश्वी.

f. (-श्वी)
A childless woman.
E.
अ priv. शिशु a child, and ङीप् fem. affix; उ becomes व.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Ill regulated, ill behaved, rude, barbarous, profligate.
E.
अ neg. शिष्ट regulated.

f. (-ता)
Rudeness, &c.
E.
तल् added to the last; also with त्व, अशिष्टत्व.

m. (-रः)
Rudeness, profligacy.
E.
अशिष्ट, and आचार practice.

m. (-रः)
The sun.
E.
अ neg. शीत cold, and कर a ray, and similar compounds, as अशीतदीधिति, अशीतमरीचि, &c.

f. sing. always. (-तिः)
Eighty.
du. (-तीः)
Two eighties.
pl. (-तयः)
Many eighties.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Octagenarian, of eighty years of age, &c.
E.
अशीति and कन् added.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
Undecayed, unimpaired.
E.
अ neg. शीर्ण decayed.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Ill behaved, vulgar, offensive.
2 Indifferent.
E.
अ neg. शील polite.

m. (-सिः)
A sword, a scymitar.
E.
अस to cast, and इन् Uṇādi aff.

f. (-शीः)
1 Wishing or bestowing a blessing.
2 A serpent's fang.
3 A kind of venom, the venom of a snake.
E.
आङ् before अश to eat, अच् and ङीप् affixes: see the preceding.

n. (-कं)
The part of the face between the under lip and the chin.
E.
अस to throw, to shine, &c. and इकन् aff.

m. (-कः)
A swordsman.
E.
असि a sword, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
One who sits.
E.
आस to sit, ण्वुल् aff.

f. (-का)
A woman servant: see असिक्नी.

f. (-क्नी)
1 A girl attending upon the inner or women's apartments.
2 A river.
E.
अ neg. and सित white, because her hair is not whitened by age: क्न is substituted for त, and the affix is ङीप्.

m. (-ण्डः)
A small pillow.

m. (-रः)
A Jaina or Buddha saint.
E.
असित black, अभ्र a cloud, and शेखर a crest: cloud-crested.

n. (-हं)
The blue lotus.
E.
असित black or dark blue, and अम्बुरुह a lotus.

m. (-र्च्चिः)
A name of VAHNI or fire.
E.
असित dark, smoky, अर्च्चिस् a ray of light.

n. (-श्म)
1 The lapis lazuli.
2 Any black or dark blue stone.
E.
असित black, and अश्मन् a stone.

n. (-लं)
The blue lotus.
E.
असित and उत्पल lotus.

n. (-लं)
The lapis lazuli.
E.
असित blue, उपल stone.

m. (-ष्ट्रः)
A marine monster, the Makara, considered as the emblem of KĀMADEVA.
E.
असि and दंष्ट्र a tooth: swordtoothed.

m. (-कः)
See the preceding.
E.
as before कन् added.

m. (-न्तः)
A crocodile: see मकर.

f. (-रा)
The edge of a sword.
E.
असि and धारा edge.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
1

Unripe.
2

Imperfect, incomplete.
3 Unaccomplished, uneffected.
4 Unproven.
E.
अ neg. and सिद्ध perfect.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
1 Accomplished, effected.
2 Put under restraint: see आसेध.
E.
आङ् before षिध to go, &c. affix क्त.

f. (-द्धिः)
1 Failure, imperfect or incomplete accomplishment.
2 (In logic,) Want of proof, conclusion not warranted by the premises.
E.
अ neg. सिद्धि completion.

m. (-वः)
An armourer, a furbisher, a sword or tool cleaner.
E.
असि and धाव who polishes; धाव to clean, अच् aff.

m. (-कः)
See the preceding.
E.
कन् added to the above.

f. (-नुः)
A knife.
E.
असि and धेनु a bow; the sword-like bow.

f. (-का)
See the preceding.
E.
as before.

m. (-त्रः)
1 The sugar cane.
2 A hell paved with swords.
n. (-त्रं)
1 A sheathe, a scabbard.
2 The blade of a sword.
E.
असि and पत्र a leaf; sharp as a sword, or enclosing it.

m. (-कः)
The sugar cane.
E.
as the preceding.

n. (-नं)
A hell where the trees have leaves as sharp as swords.
E.
असि and पत्र a leaf, वन a wood.

m. (-कः)
The gangetic porpoise, (Delphinus gangeticus, Rox.)
E.
असि, पुच्छ a tail, and कन् affix; sword tailed.

f. (-का)
Aknife.
E.
असि and पुत्रिका a daughter, an infant sword; from its smallness.

f. (-त्री)
A knife.
E.
see the preceding.

m. (-दः)
A fetid Mimosa: see विट्खदिर.
E.
असि and मेद marrow, essence; the plant being described with many thorns, and a decoction of it being demulcent^1.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-तिः)
A swordsman or soldier armed with a sword.
E.
असि and हेति a weapon.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Tinkling, applied to the ornaments worn on the hands and feet.
E.
आङ् before शिजि to tinkle, क्त aff.

n. (-वं)
Food, victuals.
m. (-वः)
Satisfaction, satiety.
E.
आशित and भव produced by, from भू and खश् aff.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Voracious, gluttonous, eating excessively.
E.
अश to eat, and तृच् affix, इ inserted.

f. (-शीः)
1 Blessing, benediction, bestowing or wishing a blessing upon others.
2 A serpent's fang.
E.
आङ् before शास to rule, क्विप् affix, and आ is changed to इ.

n. (-नं)
A blessing, a benediction.
E.
आशिस् and वचन speech.

m. (-दः)
A blessing, a benediction.
E.
आशिस् and वाद

m. (-षः)
A snake.
E.
आशी a fang, and विष poison; in whose fang is venom.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Sprinkled.
E.
आङ् before विच to sprinkle, क्त aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Sitting, seated.
E.
आस to sit, शानच् affix, form irr.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Nodding, rocking as seated, falling asleep.
E.
आसीन and प्रचलायित set in motion.
